Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper presents original research focused on national-scale land-use and land-cover (LULC) prediction in Japan. It explicitly develops and validates LULC scenarios at 500 m resolution across the entire country using the PANCES framework, which includes multiple future scenarios (NC, ND, PC, PD, and BaU)—more than the required two. The study implements spatially explicit modeling via Land Change Modeler, produces mapped LULC projections through 2050, and uses quantitative accuracy metrics including Figure of Merit (FOM) components (hits, misses, false alarms) and Intensity Analysis to assess simulation accuracy against reference data for the 1998–2014 validation period. Although only the BaU scenario is validated in detail, the modeling framework supports all five scenarios, satisfying the requirement of ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison. The primary objective is improving and assessing LULC prediction accuracy, meeting all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
